title: Extract the Sefaria TOC category-walk loop shared by curate_curricula/main.py (2x) and audit_seed.py (1x) instead of copy-pasting it

evidence.quote:
def _toc_subtree(path: str):
    """Walk Sefaria TOC categories by '/' delimited path, return the node."""
def _toc_books(category_path: str, main_subcats: list[str] | None = None):

why: The same ~10-line 'split path on / and descend library.get_toc() matching category nodes' loop (identical toc/parts/node/contents/match variable names) is copy-pasted three times — twice inside main.py itself (_toc_subtree and _toc_books duplicate each other) and once more in audit_seed.py. A change to how Sefaria's TOC node shape is walked (e.g. a new category key) has to be found and patched in three places, and nothing keeps them in sync if only one gets fixed.
recommendation: Extract a shared `_walk_toc_path(path) -> node | None` helper (e.g. a small tool/sefaria_toc_utils.py importable by both scripts) and have _toc_subtree, _toc_books, and _books_in_category call it.
acceptance_criteria: Only one implementation of the TOC-path-walk loop exists across tool/curate_curricula/main.py and tool/audit_seed.py
Sample category path (e.g. Talmud/Bavli/Seder Zeraim) resolves identically before/after the refactor
